purpose: Attribute the EXPLORATORY_NULL of the 2025 disjoint cross (FCLR-FWD-VOL-2025-DISJOINT-CROSS-20261114T183000Z: pooled C2-B1 mean diff +0.006923, relative reduction -1.963%, 95% CI [-0.012604, 0.028030]) to estimator behaviour or to a data-lineage defect on the cached 2025 panel. Two-by-two attribution matrix over {existing panel, cleaned lineage copy} x {sealed estimator, corrected estimator}. All results EXPLORATORY_ONLY, promotable=false. Does not reopen any sealed verdict.

splits.design: three disjoint 30-day test blocks, each with its own 30-day train window
splits.block_rule: no padding, no imputation; any row-key or feature-lineage mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE

sealed.definition: raw (unstandardised) feature columns, ridge-stabilised normal equations (1e-10 on the diagonal), plain exp back-transform with no smearing, no target-derived fills; reproduces the reference estimator conventions used before this campaign

corrected.definition: train-only column means/std, finite-feature masking, train-only Duan smearing on log-target residuals, OLS via least squares, explicit missingness policy (drop row, never zero-fill, never forward-fill)

cleaned.description: lineage-preserving copy: removes the corrupted XRPUSDT mark rows for 2025-10-19 (close column holds premium-index values), recomputes XRP rolling RV and forward targets after removal, imputes nothing

primary_metric: paired out-of-sample QLIKE difference, C2 vs B1, 24h target

inference.bootstrap: day-block bootstrap over complete UTC days, pooled across blocks
inference.holm_family: horizon x contrast (primary C2_vs_B1 reported with family adjustment)
inference.loio: leave one instrument out of training, evaluate on the held-out instrument

verdict_rule.EXPLAINED_BY_ESTIMATOR: the 2x2 matrix shows a same-data estimator swing of at least 1.0 percentage point that is at least 3x any same-estimator data swing on the primary contrast
verdict_rule.EXPLAINED_BY_DATA: the 2x2 matrix shows a same-estimator cleaned-vs-existing swing of at least 1.0 percentage point that is at least 3x any same-panel estimator swing
verdict_rule.UNEXPLAINED: no dimension produces a material, dominant swing
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: row-key/lineage check fails, or a cell cannot be fitted

forbidden: re-running the tested disjoint test months
relabeling an exploratory result as confirmatory
threshold shopping or feature changes after outcome inspection
declaring Gate 4 Binance v5 terms evidence resolved
